evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Not asked. Rep moved directly into logistics probing without asking about customer's two primary concerns (on-time movers or damage to items).
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concerns were surfaced because the two-concerns question was never asked. N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Rep noted 'Friday is one of our peak days' and gave the rate but did not offer a cheaper alternative day as a total dollar amount savings, nor did she ask about date flexibility. Partial credit only for naming the day category.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Never asked. Rep ended the call with 'I'll be sending everything to your email to then finalize the estimate' and never asked for the business or mentioned rate lock/no deposit commitment.

top_strength: Danah gathered detailed logistics efficiently, asked clarifying questions about pod sizes and storage location, and delivered a personalized estimate range ($545–$872) anchored to the specific job details.
coaching_note: The call skipped the two foundational steps of the card: no quid pro quo framing at the open, no two-concerns question before probing, no promises delivered, and no ask for the business at the close — focus on leading with what matters to Jessica and closing with a clear call to action.
